titulo: Segundo condicional: situações imaginárias: Revisão e prática da aula 41

aula.objetivo: Usar o segundo condicional («If I had…, I would…») para situações irreais ou improváveis, dar conselhos com «If I were you», e usar «wish» para desejos no presente.

itens.enunciado: Ouça e escolha.
itens.audio: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world
opcoes: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world
If I win the lottery, I will travel the world
If I would win the lottery, I travel the world
itens.gabarito: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world

itens.enunciado: Ouça e escolha.
itens.audio: If I were you, I would call him
opcoes: If I were you, I would call him
If I was you, I will call him
If I am you, I would call him
itens.gabarito: If I were you, I would call him

itens.enunciado: Ouça e escreva.
itens.audio: I wish I had more time
itens.respostaEsperada: I wish I had more time
itens.explicacao: Escreva: I wish I had more time.

itens.enunciado: Ouça e escreva.
Qual frase está correta?
opcoes: If I had money, I would buy a house.
If I would have money, I would buy a house.
If I have money, I would buy a house.
itens.gabarito: If I had money, I would buy a house.

itens.enunciado: Qual frase é segundo condicional?
opcoes: If I were rich, I would travel.
If it rains, I will stay home.
If I see her, I will say hello.
itens.gabarito: If I were rich, I would travel.

itens.enunciado: Qual frase dá um conselho?
opcoes: If I were you, I would apologize.
If I was you, I apologize.
If I am you, I would apologize.
itens.gabarito: If I were you, I would apologize.

itens.enunciado: Qual frase está correta?
opcoes: I wish I could speak French.
I wish I can speak French.
I wish I will speak French.
itens.gabarito: I wish I could speak French.

itens.enunciado: If she ___ here, she would help us. (estivesse)
What ___ you do if you won?
I wish I ___ more time. (tivesse)
If we had more time, we ___ visit the museum.
Ordene: «If I were rich, I would travel.»
itens.gabarito: If I were rich, I would travel.

itens.enunciado: Ordene: «What would you do if you won?»
itens.gabarito: What would you do if you won?

itens.enunciado: Escreva 4 frases: uma com «If I won…», um conselho com «If I were you», um desejo com «I wish» e uma pergunta com «What would you do…?»
itens.respostaEsperada: If I won the lottery, I would travel. If I were you, I would talk to him. I wish I had more time. What would you do if you were rich?

itens.enunciado: Dê dois conselhos a um amigo usando a estrutura clássica If I were you, I'd… / I wouldn't….
itens.respostaEsperada: If I were you, I'd accept the job offer, and I wouldn't worry about moving.

itens.enunciado: Conte duas coisas que você faria se tivesse mais tempo livre ou se morasse em outro país (If I had… / If I lived…, I'd…).
itens.respostaEsperada: If I had more free time, I'd learn how to play the cello, and if I lived in Italy, I'd eat pasta every day.

itens.enunciado: Reflita sobre um fato do passado que teria sido diferente usando a Third Conditional (If I had / hadn't…, I would / wouldn't have…).
itens.respostaEsperada: If I hadn't studied English, I wouldn't have gotten my current job.

itens.enunciado: Escreva um desejo sobre o seu presente (I wish I…) e um arrependimento sobre algo do passado (I wish I had / hadn't…).
itens.respostaEsperada: I wish I lived closer to the beach, and I wish I had started saving money ten years ago.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: If I would have more money right now, I would buy a new apartment.
itens.respostaEsperada: If I had more money right now, I would buy a new apartment.
itens.explicacao: Veja a chave comentada no livro.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: If you would have called me yesterday, I would have picked you up.
itens.respostaEsperada: If you had called me yesterday, I would have picked you up.
itens.explicacao: Veja a chave comentada no livro.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: I wish I know how to play the piano!
itens.respostaEsperada: I wish I knew how to play the piano!
itens.explicacao: Veja a chave comentada no livro.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: If I knew yesterday that she was sick, I would have visited her.
itens.respostaEsperada: If I had known yesterday that she was sick, I would have visited her.
itens.explicacao: Veja a chave comentada no livro.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: I forgot my jacket! I wish I brought it with me this morning.
itens.respostaEsperada: I forgot my jacket! I wish I had brought it with me this morning.
itens.explicacao: Veja a chave comentada no livro.

itens.enunciado: Corrija: I wish you pass your driving test tomorrow!
itens.respostaEsperada: I hope you pass your driving test tomorrow!
itens.explicacao: Veja a chave comentada no livro.

itens.enunciado: Esta frase tem erro? Corrija ou escreva «OK»: If we had left ten minutes earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.

blocos.explicacao: PASSO 1: Os três erros mais comuns nas condicionais hipotéticas são: colocar would ou would have dentro da cláusula do If (If I would have time / If I would have known), usar o Past Simple em vez do Past Perfect (had + 3ª) para falar do passado irreversível (If I knew yesterday, I would have told you; o certo é If I had known yesterday) e usar o presente depois de I wish (I wish I have em vez de I wish I had). PASSO 2: Releia a tabela e diga cada frase certa em voz alta antes de olhar o motivo.

erros.errado: If I would have time, I'd go.
erros.certo: If I had time, I'd go.
erros.motivo: Na cláusula do If, use o Past Simple (had), e não would.

erros.errado: If you would have told me, I'd have helped.
erros.certo: If you had told me, I'd have helped.
erros.motivo: Na Third Conditional, a cláusula do If exige had + 3ª coluna, e não would have.

erros.errado: If I knew yesterday, I would have gone.
erros.certo: If I had known yesterday, I would have gone.
erros.motivo: Em português dizemos “Se eu soubesse ontem”, mas como é passado encerrado, o inglês exige If I had known.

erros.errado: I wish I have more time today.
erros.certo: I wish I had more time today.
erros.motivo: Desejos irreais no presente após I wish exigem o verbo no Passado (had, lived, could).

erros.errado: I wish I studied harder last year.
erros.certo: I wish I had studied harder last year.
erros.motivo: Arrependimentos sobre o passado após I wish exigem had + 3ª coluna.
O som 've (ãv) é a contração de have, e não da preposição of.

blocos.texto: Já consigo? Falar de situações hipotéticas hoje usando If + Past Simple e would, incluindo If I were you. · Analisar o passado dizendo o que teria acontecido com If + had + 3ª coluna e would have + 3ª coluna sem usar would na parte do If. · Expressar desejos sobre o presente (I wish I had/could…) e arrependimentos sobre o passado (I wish I had/hadn't…).

blocos.enunciado: Retorno. 1. Do Capítulo 21 e 22. Compare: (a) If I find your keys, I'll call you. (b) If I found a wallet on the street, I'd give it to the police. (c) If I had found your keys yesterday, I would have called you. Qual delas é uma promessa real para hoje, qual é uma hipótese imaginária e qual é sobre ontem? 2. Do Capítulo 20. Adicione a question tag: You would accept that job in London, ____? 3. Do Capítulo 16 e 22. Na frase If I'd known, I'd have told you, expanda os dois 'd: qual é had e qual é would?
